snippet.title: Does The Moon Dream | Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The world is falling apart. Monsters that were once people stalk the streets. Food is running out, people are dying. Hope is lost.

You alone carry the spark that can burn away the darkness and bring light to people's hearts.

    Approx. 1 Hour Long Playtime - This demo covers a complete segment of the game with narrative, exploration, and combat segments.
    Affect Who Lives and Dies - Rescue the missing survivors and complete their tasks to ensure you're ready for the night. Be careful, leave tasks unfinished and people will die.
    Directional, Grid-Based Combat - Brutal grid-based combat with directional attacking and blocking that requires both quick reflexes and strategic thinking.
    A Love Letter to PS2 Horror - Inspired by the likes of Killer7, King's Field 4, and the Silent Hill series, with a unique retro horror aesthetic.

Does The Moon Dream's Rainy Town Demo is playable right now on Steam and Itch io

- Made By Caleb Draper
